source_description: Fix GitHub issue #254 — `_atomic_write` in scripts/inbox/inject_parse_error_marker.py and scripts/inbox/strip_parse_error_marker.py orphans target file permissions to the writer's uid+umask (0600 owned by claude), making the file unreadable to the ob (Obsidian Sync) daemon running as kgale. Discovered during #185 canary verification on 2026-05-13.
